digest: Investigation into a single failed VPN login for m.alvarez concluded that it was a benign event, likely a mistyped password, immediately followed by a successful MFA-confirmed login from the same registered device and usual IP address. No malicious activity detected. AUDIT-CANARY-9F2A

evidence_findings.title: Failed VPN Authentication
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: A VPN authentication attempt for user m.alvarez from IP 198.51.100.24 failed at approximately 2026-08-17T08:03:00Z.
evidence_findings.conclusion: This event is consistent with a mistyped password, as indicated by the subsequent successful login and case context.

evidence_findings.title: Successful VPN Authentication
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: A successful MFA-confirmed VPN login for user m.alvarez from IP 198.51.100.24 occurred at 2026-08-17T08:04:00Z, one minute after the failed attempt. The login originated from the user's registered corporate device and usual home address.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The user successfully authenticated after the initial failure, confirming a likely user error rather than an attack attempt.
